segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The heavy wooden door of the Rusty Anchor groans open, letting in a sharp gust of freezing mountain wind.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Inside, the air is thick with the stench of stale ale, wet wool, and simmering fear.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Two wretched goblin scouts sit near the hearth, their yellow eyes fixing hungrily upon you as they draw crude blades.

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and step forward to engage the goblins
Shout a warning and hold your ground behind your shield
Reach for your health potion just in case

turns.total_text: The heavy wooden door of the Rusty Anchor groans open, letting in a sharp gust of freezing mountain wind. Inside, the air is thick with the stench of stale ale, wet wool, and simmering fear. Two wretched goblin scouts sit near the hearth, their yellow eyes fixing hungrily upon you as they draw crude blades. Fresh meat for the fire!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael surges forward, boots slamming against the wooden floorboards of the tavern as the first goblin lunges with its crude blade.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The thrust glances harmlessly off your chain mail with a harsh scrape of metal.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With practiced fury, you retaliate, bringing your longsword down in a sweeping arc that catches the scout across the chest.

suggestions.text: Follow up with a fierce shield bash against the wounded goblin
Slash wildly with your longsword to finish off the first scout
Shift your stance to defend against both enemies

turns.action: I race through the dungeon, chasing the goblin!
turns.total_text: Kael surges forward, boots slamming against the wooden floorboards of the tavern as the first goblin lunges with its crude blade. The thrust glances harmlessly off your chain mail with a harsh scrape of metal. With practiced fury, you retaliate, bringing your longsword down in a sweeping arc that catches the scout across the chest. Gah! Kill the big one!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The tavern walls suddenly tremble, and with a deafening crack, the upper loft gives way, sending heavy timbers crashing down and splitting the floorboards into a sudden, yawning chasm.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael springs into action, launching himself across the jagged gap as splintering wood and dust rain into the dark void below.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You land hard on the far side, scrambling for purchase and pulling yourself safely onto solid stone as the goblins screech in frustration from across the divide.

suggestions.text: Search the rubble around you for an alternative route
Shout a taunt at the stranded goblins and ready your weapon
Look for a way to secure a rope and swing back across

turns.action: I leap across the chasm to escape the collapsing bridge!
